file.description:
The file that contains the links to be resolved.

This field is provided by DocumentationRenderer before starting to render links for a particular documentation
file.

endpoint.description:
Return a logical URI intended for use by the developer portal. Full URLs remain
as-is and relative URLs return null.

| Kind         | path            | URI                         |
|--------------|-----------------|-----------------------------|
| TYPE         | User            | doc:type:User               |
| DATA_FIELD   | User#groups     | doc:data-field:User#groups  |
| METHOD_FIELD | User#fetch      | doc:method-field:User#fetch |
| TOPIC        | typesys.c3doc   | typesys                     |
| URL          | http://c3iot.ai | http://c3iot.ai             |
| URL          | img/diagram.png |                             |

@see DocumentationKind

version.description: The version to use when constructing the documentation link.

title: Documentation link builder for the developer portal.
name: DevPortalDocumentationLinkBuilder
